name: D'Arcy McGee's Irish Pub
problem: Create a welcoming restaurant website with a practical admin dashboard for managing pub content.
flows: Guests browse the menu, events, and pub information.
Staff review and manage content through the dashboard.
Reviewers open the embedded demo or the full demo in a new tab.
decisions: Keep the portfolio page static and load the demo only in an iframe.
Use localStorage in the public demo to avoid requiring live credentials.
